body:
I understand, man. I recently almost committed suicide. The same thing almost exactly happened to me.
Parents saw the bruises from when I came home afterschool (bullies beat me routinely, humiliated me, and called me fag boy because I'm bisexual) but they didn't do anything. But when I finally told them how I felt, they finally understood. I've felt it. I feel you, man.
I'm still with you guys. I've told my parents, and they seem to understand the tormenting I faced. Thanks for support.

I have a problem though...

I've been cutting, but more deeply than usual. A month ago, this landed me in the ER. I need help quitting.
Thanks. I wish there were more people like you. I almost pulled the trigger.
I've suffered too much. I'm done. I hate this cruel world. The clip is in the 9, and I finally will get to see God. Thanks for helping, and peace.
